reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's unmodified AICPA examination signed September 29, 2026 covers August 17 and August 31 at 5:00pm Eastern Time. The rendered page 5 month-end column reports Treasury bills $1,557,070,479, government money-market funds $467,625,232 and cash deposits $421,617,153, summing exactly to $2,446,312,864 against 2,325,969,308 outstanding RLUSD. The August 31 column alone supplies this composition; the August 17 column is not blended. Stable row keys match the hash-bound producer. Depository and fund identities remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the RLUSD Reserve Report as of August 31, 2026 at 5:00pm Eastern Time
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material asset-class exposure is unclassified; the public report does not identify the depository institutions, money market funds, or custodians.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ripple's July 9, 2025 press release names BNY as the primary RLUSD reserve custodian, and the Deloitte report plus stablecoin terms confirm segregated reserve accounts held with NYDFS-approved U.S. depositories or custodians. Custody allocation shares, the identities of any additional depository institutions, statutory bankruptcy remoteness, and reserve-wide rehypothecation treatment remain undisclosed.
